trace.notes: Original input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5872226.

Local shard metadata identified zbMATH record 5872226 as 'Controlling underactuated mechanical systems: a review and open problems' (2011) with no embedded full-text links. Exact-title recovery identified DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-16135-3_7 for the same chapter by Zhong-Ping Jiang in Lecture Notes in Control and Information Sciences volume 407, pages 77-88.

Failure mode paywalled_or_restricted: the Springer landing page confirmed the exact chapter but exposed only an abstract, references, and a subscription-preview access notice, not readable full text containing the open-problem section.

Bounded recovery after resolver identification used exact-work searches by title plus PDF, DOI plus PDF, and title plus author. Candidate pages inspected included NYU Scholars metadata, Springer chapter and book pages, the author's publication list, and search results that were citing papers or different works; none provided a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML text.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/5872226.json and outputs/latest.json.
